rationale: C104 flagged zero fair_value rows. The raw schedule of investments prints dash values in the Fair Value column for representative flagged zero-value positions, including rows whose principal/shares and percentage of net assets are also dash-like and whose amortized cost may be zero or negative. The stored fair_value of 0.0 is therefore a faithful normalization of the filing disclosure rather than a data error; the warning is a legitimate review rule firing on source-disclosed zero fair value.
